nodes.name: media_stream.rs
nodes.summary: Implements GStreamer media stream types, wrapping audio/video pipeline elements that can be attached to a GStreamer pipeline and produce encoded output for RTP transmission.

nodes.name: media_stream_source.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a custom GStreamer source element (ServoMediaStreamSrc) that bridges servo-media streams into the GStreamer pipeline as a source pad, handling stream attachment and buffer pushing.

nodes.name: player.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a comprehensive GStreamer-based media player supporting playback control (play/pause/seek/volume), audio/video track management, metadata extraction, and renderer integration for multiple platforms.

nodes.name: registry_scanner.rs
nodes.summary: Lazily scans the GStreamer registry to determine which container formats and codecs are supported by the host system, providing capability queries for media type matching.

nodes.name: render.rs
nodes.summary: Provides GStreamer video frame rendering abstraction with platform-specific implementations for Linux/Unix and Android, converting GStreamer samples into renderable video frames.

nodes.name: source.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a custom GStreamer source element (ServoSrc) using the GStreamer subclassing API, providing a configurable data source with seek support for media playback.

nodes.name: webrtc.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a GStreamer WebRTC controller that manages WebRTC peer connections, including SDP negotiation, ICE candidate handling, media stream linking, and data channel management.

nodes.name: GStreamerMediaStream
nodes.summary: GStreamer implementation of a media stream, managing a collection of pipeline elements that can produce encoded audio/video data for transmission.

nodes.name: GstreamerMediaSocket
nodes.summary: A proxy media socket that delegates sink operations to an internal audio socket.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new GStreamerMediaStream with the given stream type and pipeline elements.

nodes.name: caps
nodes.summary: Builds and returns the GStreamer caps representing the combined capabilities of all stream elements.

nodes.name: caps_with_payload
nodes.summary: Builds stream caps including the payload type for RTP encoding configuration.

nodes.name: attach_to_pipeline
nodes.summary: Adds all stream elements to a GStreamer pipeline and links them in sequence.

nodes.name: pipeline_or_new
nodes.summary: Returns the existing pipeline or creates a new one, adding stream elements to it.

nodes.name: create_video
nodes.summary: Creates video pipeline elements for encoded video output with configurable codec parameters.

nodes.name: encoded
nodes.summary: Creates the encoded media output by building the encoding pipeline with appropriate encoders, payloaders, and RTP caps.

nodes.name: create_video_from
nodes.summary: Creates a video stream from an existing source element with encoding pipeline setup.

nodes.name: create_audio
nodes.summary: Creates audio pipeline elements for encoded audio output with Opus encoding configuration.

nodes.name: create_audio_from
nodes.summary: Creates an audio stream from an existing source element with Opus encoding pipeline.

nodes.name: create_proxy
nodes.summary: Creates a proxy media socket connecting the stream output to a downstream consumer.

nodes.name: add_stream
nodes.summary: Adds a media stream to the MediaSink for output routing.

nodes.name: set_stream
nodes.summary: Attaches a servo-media stream to the GStreamer source element as the data provider.

nodes.name: register_servo_media_stream_src
nodes.summary: Registers the ServoMediaStreamSrc GStreamer element type in the GStreamer registry for pipeline construction.

nodes.name: PlayerInner
nodes.summary: Internal player state managing the GStreamer playbin element, stream selection, buffering, seeking, and media metadata.

nodes.name: SeekChannel
nodes.summary: IPC channel wrapper for coordinating seek operations between the player and backend threads.

nodes.name: GStreamerPlayer
nodes.summary: Public player interface wrapping PlayerInner with setup, lifecycle management, and platform-specific renderer integration.

nodes.name: metadata_from_media_info
nodes.summary: Extracts media metadata (duration, audio/video tracks) from a GStreamer PlayMediaInfo structure.

nodes.name: set_input_size
nodes.summary: Sets the expected input data size for stream playback.

nodes.name: set_seekable
nodes.summary: Enables or disables seeking capability on the player stream.

nodes.name: set_mute
nodes.summary: Mutes or unmutes the audio output of the player.

nodes.name: set_playback_rate
nodes.summary: Sets the playback speed factor, with rate limiting to 8x maximum.

nodes.name: play
nodes.summary: Starts or resumes media playback from the current position.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops media playback and resets the player state.

nodes.name: pause
nodes.summary: Pauses media playback at the current position.

nodes.name: end_of_stream
nodes.summary: Marks the end of the input stream and waits for pipeline playback to complete.

nodes.name: seek
nodes.summary: Seeks to a specific time position in the media, waiting for the seek operation to complete via IPC.

nodes.name: set_volume
nodes.summary: Sets the audio volume level for playback.

nodes.name: push_data
nodes.summary: Pushes a data buffer into the player appsrc element for processing.

nodes.name: buffered
nodes.summary: Returns the buffered time ranges available for seeking in the media.

nodes.name: seekable
nodes.summary: Reports whether the current media stream supports seeking operations.

nodes.name: set_stream
nodes.summary: Configures the player to play from a servo-media stream by attaching stream source elements.

nodes.name: new@2
nodes.summary: Creates a new GStreamerPlayer with the given ID, context, communication channels, and renderer instances.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Sets up the complete GStreamer playback pipeline with playbin, source elements, video/audio sinks, renderers, and signal handlers.

nodes.name: drop
nodes.summary: Destructor that stops the player, sends shutdown events, and tears down the GStreamer pipeline.

nodes.name: GStreamerRegistryScanner
nodes.summary: Caches supported MIME types and codecs by scanning the GStreamer plugin registry.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Scans the GStreamer registry to discover all available decoder, demuxer, and parser elements, building sets of supported MIME types and codecs.

nodes.name: has_element_for_media_type
nodes.summary: Checks if GStreamer has an element capable of handling a specific media type by registry factory lookup.

nodes.name: GStreamerRender
nodes.summary: Platform-specific GStreamer video renderer that extracts video frames from GStreamer samples and delivers them for display.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new GStreamer renderer with the given GL context, using the platform-specific implementation.

nodes.name: is_gl
nodes.summary: Returns whether the renderer uses OpenGL for video frame rendering.

nodes.name: get_frame_from_sample
nodes.summary: Extracts a video frame from a GStreamer sample, converting it to the renderer frame format and copying buffer data.

nodes.name: setup_video_sink
nodes.summary: Configures a GStreamer video sink element with the renderer GL context and frame callback for displaying video output.

nodes.name: push_buffer
nodes.summary: Pushes a data buffer into the GStreamer appsrc for downstream processing in the pipeline.

nodes.name: register_servo_src
nodes.summary: Registers the ServoSrc GStreamer element type in the GStreamer type system for use in pipeline construction.

nodes.name: GStreamerWebRtcController
nodes.summary: GStreamer WebRTC controller managing peer connection state, SDP offer/answer exchange, ICE candidate handling, media stream linking, and data channels.

nodes.name: create_offer
nodes.summary: Creates a WebRTC SDP offer by triggering negotiation on the GStreamer webrtcbin element.

nodes.name: create_answer
nodes.summary: Creates a WebRTC SDP answer in response to a received offer from the remote peer.

nodes.name: add_stream
nodes.summary: Adds a media stream to the WebRTC pipeline, linking it to the webrtcbin element for transmission.

nodes.name: close_data_channel
nodes.summary: Closes a WebRTC data channel by ID, notifying the event target and updating the internal channel tracking.

nodes.name: send_data_channel_message
nodes.summary: Sends a binary or text message on a specific WebRTC data channel.

nodes.name: internal_event
nodes.summary: Processes internal WebRTC events including SDP offers, ICE candidates, stream additions, and data channel requests.

nodes.name: set_description
nodes.summary: Sets a local or remote SDP description on the webrtcbin element.

nodes.name: store_remote_mline_info
nodes.summary: Parses a remote SDP offer to extract media line caps and payload types for stream matching.

nodes.name: link_stream
nodes.summary: Links a local media stream to the WebRTC peer connection by matching stream types to remote m-lines and connecting pads.

nodes.name: flush_pending_streams
nodes.summary: Processes and links any streams queued during negotiation setup.

nodes.name: start_pipeline
nodes.summary: Starts the GStreamer pipeline and the WebRTC signalling handshake, creating offers or processing pending streams.

nodes.name: construct
nodes.summary: Constructs a new GStreamerWebRtcController by setting up the webrtcbin element, pads, and event handlers.

nodes.name: on_offer_or_answer_created
nodes.summary: Handles SDP offer/answer creation events by setting the generated session description on the webrtcbin.

nodes.name: on_incoming_stream
nodes.summary: Handles incoming media streams from the remote peer by associating them with GStreamerMediaStream instances.

nodes.name: on_incoming_decodebin_stream
nodes.summary: Handles decodebin streams from incoming WebRTC media by creating a media stream with appropriate RTP depayloader.

nodes.name: process_new_stream
nodes.summary: Integrates a newly received media stream into the internal stream tracking system.

nodes.name: candidate
nodes.summary: Processes an ICE candidate received from the remote peer and adds it to the webrtcbin.

nodes.name: register_data_channel
nodes.summary: Creates and registers a new data channel from a GStreamer WebRTC data channel, linking it to servo-media data channel types.
